checklist.action: Update Plex Media Server from 1.43.3.10860 to 1.43.3.10861 or newer
checklist.why: Plex Media Server before 1.43.3.10861 has four actively exploited flaws (CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, CVE-2026-96656).

checklist.action: Rebuild the env with litellm 1.106.2 and rotate every key it could read
checklist.why: LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI and Docker shipped a credential stealer and a remote code loader; 1.106.2 is the last safe release.
